tags.title: Tags / categories
tags.description: Filter jobs by RemoteOK tag, e.g. "javascript", "design", "marketing". Leave empty to fetch all tags.

search.title: Keyword search
search.description: Only keep jobs whose position, company, or description contains this keyword (case-insensitive). Leave empty to skip keyword filtering.

maxItems.title: Max jobs to return
maxItems.description: Maximum number of job listings to save to the dataset.
